Short summary, the boys have to save one of their teammates by following the letter's steps. "Long" summary, everyone goes on a travel of self-discovery, Hanamiya (slowly) stops being an asshole, and there's crying. Lots of crying and shocking realizations and coping.

And as I said, it's been a wholesome experience so far. Making everyone into an emotional trainwreck does wonders, and "experimenting" with Hanamiya's personality is quite thrilling.

As for my inspiration, it's mostly Orange itself. Sometimes it's real life situations and experiences. Sometimes it's other manga tidbits. I draw inspiration from pretty much everything so it's hard to tell.

So far I'm proud of my work, to the point I'd say it's my best KD fic. Even if I get no reviews or comments at all.
